"Whew!" exclaimed Joe Matson, his bronzed face showing the proclamation. "What is it, Joe?" asked Clara, as she laid down a letter she was reading. "What is it?" she says again, laying down her own correspondence. "Dont tell me its more trouble?-- something about dads business?"

"I won't be doing that--but if what this says is true things will certainly look very different for me". Joe looks out into the yard, a snowscape, gazing but not fully noticing the flurry of flakes falling to the ground. "It looks like I wont be in the Central Baseball League much longer"

"Oh Joe, after all of the progress you made and helping them win the mount! What a shame

" It could be pleasant and maybe ill make a lot more money"

"I don't understand what you're saying"

"My pitching arm"

Joe grabs a ball and throws it just as Mrs. Matson comes in the door with a pitcher of water. The ball hits the jug and water goes all over the floor.
